# Nxt Apex AI — llms.txt
# https://nxtapexai.com

## About
Nxt Apex AI is an AI consulting firm founded by Sean Conerly (MIT-trained AI strategist).
We help businesses implement AI that drives measurable revenue and operational efficiency.
Our core framework is CILAS: Context, Inputs, Logic, Automation, System.

## Services
- AI Readiness Assessment: We audit a business's current tools, workflows, and team capability and deliver a custom AI implementation roadmap.
- AI Team Training: Hands-on training on Claude, AI Search Visibility, and custom workflow tools — built around each client's actual processes.
- Custom AI Workflows: We build automations that connect existing software, eliminate manual work, and deliver ROI generic tools can't match.
- AI Search Visibility (AEO): We optimize how businesses appear in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview answers. We audit citation signals, fix structured data, and connect AI-referred leads to a pipeline built to close.

## Founder
Sean Conerly — AI strategist, MIT background. Focused on practical AI implementation for small and mid-sized businesses.
Contact: sean@nxtapexai.com | (504) 290-4780
